label: sshow
description: Show a screen by index (starting from 0) and return the active screen index.

label: snext
description: Switch to the next screen and return the active screen index.

label: sprev
description: Switch to the previous screen and return the active screen index.

label: sindex
description: Return the active screen index without changing it.

label: sval
description: Set a text or number on a Data screen slot until the next refresh.

label: sreset
description: Restore a Data screen slot to its configured template value.

label: srefresh
description: Redraw the active screen from the current data.

label: swipe
detail:
horizontal swipe on the display
$e0=direction:number (+1/-1)
$e1=screen index:number
